text: In {year} the {faction} dug into the {place} and found {thing}.
{npc} sealed the {place} in {year}; the key was never named.
{thing} left the {place} in {year} and was not seen again.
Fire took the {place} in {year}; only {thing} survived.
{npc} wrote that the {faction} feared {thing} below the {place}.
In {year} the {faction} and {npc} traded {thing} at the {place}.
The {place} fell silent in {year}; {npc} warned of {thing}.
Rats took the {place} in {year}; the {faction} burned {thing}.
{npc} mapped the {place} in {year} and hid {thing} there.
After {year} only {npc} entered the {place}, and took {thing}.
